dataset.name: Case CNP metastatic TNBC cohort (GSE241876)
dataset.description: Prospective metastatic triple-negative breast-cancer cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA sequencing and individual progression-free survival during carboplatin, nab-paclitaxel and pembrolizumab.
dataset.cohort_context: Thirty patients entered the single-arm phase-II CNP trial. GEO publishes bulk RNA profiles for 15 pretreatment biopsies and four on-treatment biopsies from four of those patients. TRACE Explorer excludes every post-treatment profile before endpoint and expression QC, retaining one baseline tumor per patient.
dataset.publication_citation: Wilkerson et al. Clinical Cancer Research 2024

metadata.source_program: Case Comprehensive Cancer Center phase-II CNP trial NCT03121352
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and the CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 publication
metadata.library_method: Pretreatment core-biopsy bulk RNA-seq aligned with STAR 2.7.6a and quantified with featureCounts against human GENCODE release 42 (GRCh38.p13)
metadata.endpoint_context: Progression-free survival during carboplatin, nab-paclitaxel and pembrolizumab in metastatic TNBC
metadata.endpoint_definition_note: The publication defines PFS from biopsy to radiographic progression or death, censoring patients alive without progression at last follow-up.
metadata.sample_selection_note: The full-match title rule retains 15 baseline profiles, including four suffixed PRE, and excludes R008_POST, R010_POST, R014_POST and R018_POST before patient and endpoint QC.
metadata.source_inconsistency_note: The GEO README says reads were aligned to mm10 but in the same sentence specifies Human GENCODE release 42 (GRCh38.p13). The peer-reviewed Methods state hg38, and every matrix feature is a human Ensembl/GENCODE identifier. TRACE Explorer records the README inconsistency and uses the human GENCODE annotation supported by the article and matrix.
metadata.overlap_note: This prospective single-arm trial is distinct from TCGA-BRCA and the other treatment cohorts represented in the catalog.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO files in place. Source-file redistribution is disabled; NCBI GEO and article-license terms remain controlling.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment primary or metastatic TNBC core biopsy

expression.label: GEO featureCounts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned human GENCODE release 42 GRCh38.p13 gene_name annotation
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols mapped from more than one source GENCODE row are excluded rather than combined without a source-defined rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes library size over all 50,641 source rows, converts featureCounts values to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). Only the 15 pretreatment columns are retained; values are not cross-study normalized.

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival during CNP therapy
endpoints.event_definition: Radiographic disease progression or death, whichever occurred first
